# lmw messages send

Send a message (asks for confirmation)

### Synopsis

Send a message to a member (--to) or to an existing conversation
(--conversation), after showing it and asking you to type 'send'.

LinkedIn only lets you message your connections, and others when your
account allows it.

```
lmw messages send [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw messages send --to ada-lovelace --text "Hi Ada!"
  lmw messages send --conversation 2-ZTU4MDlh... --text-file reply.txt
```

### Options

```
      --conversation string   the conversation to reply in
  -h, --help                  help for send
      --text string           message text
      --text-file string      file with the message text
      --to string             the member to write to (profile address or name)
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
  -v, --verbose   show debug logs, including every API request
```
